description: Earth System Trend & Regional Paradox Workbench for NASA Space Apps Challenge
challenge_track: Be An Earth System Trend Detective!

cases.title: The Monsoon Paradox: Orographic Deluge vs. Rain-Shadow Drought
cases.subtitle: Marathwada vs. Northeast India (2001–2025)
cases.paradox_statement: Despite sharing the same South Asian summer monsoon air mass, why does Northeast India receive up to 1,350+ mm/month causing extreme flash flooding, while Marathwada (just 1,500 km away) suffers persistent agro-meteorological drought (<10 mm/month)?
cases.scientific_driver: Western Ghats rain-shadow effect vs. Bay of Bengal orographic funneling into Khasi Hills.

regions.expected_climatology: Semi-arid rain shadow, erratic monsoon onset, high drought frequency
World-record orographic monsoon rainfall, extreme convective cloud bursts

detective_clues: Compare peak monsoon months (July-August) across both regions.
Analyze rainfall variability: Marathwada exhibits coefficient of variation >45%.
Correlate dry season precipitation deficits with regional water stress.

cases.title: Land Thermal Paradox: Deforestation Warming vs. Irrigation Cooling
cases.subtitle: Rondônia Amazon Arc vs. Punjab Irrigated Belt (2001–2025)
cases.paradox_statement: Why is daytime Land Surface Temperature accelerating upward across cleared Amazon rainforest, whereas Punjab's intensive agricultural belt exhibits strong evaporative cooling anomalies despite substantial atmospheric greenhouse warming?
cases.scientific_driver: Canopy clearance in Rondônia eliminates latent heat evaporative cooling, converting solar energy to sensible surface heat (+4°C to +8°C). In Punjab, canal and tubewell irrigation amplifies latent evaporative flux, suppressing daytime skin temperatures.

regions.expected_climatology: Persistent tropical warming anomaly, dry season LST spikes >40°C
Subtropical continental climate, strong summer evaporative cooling dip

detective_clues: Notice the dry season (August-October) LST surge in Rondônia post-2005.
Contrast with Punjab's June pre-monsoon heat vs August irrigation crop canopy cooling.
Verify cloud-filtered retrievals: zero 0.0 K artifacts remain.

cases.title: Vegetation Greenness Paradox: Canopy Degradation vs. Human-Engineered Greening
cases.subtitle: Rondônia Amazon Arc vs. Punjab Irrigated Belt (2001–2025)
cases.paradox_statement: Why has dense pristine rainforest canopy in Rondônia experienced fragmentation and dry-season brown-downs, while Punjab's semi-arid terrain shows sustained bimodal vegetation greenness peaks?
cases.scientific_driver: Amazon arc deforestation replaces perennial evergreen canopy (NDVI ~0.75-0.85) with cattle pasture and soy fields (NDVI fluctuating down to ~0.30 in dry season). Punjab uses Green Revolution double-cropping (Kharif rice + Rabi wheat) to artificially drive high bimodal NDVI peaks.

regions.expected_climatology: Degraded tropical forest transitioning to pasture seasonal amplitude
Distinct dual-season peaks (Feb-Mar wheat, Sep-Oct rice)

detective_clues: Inspect the seasonal cycle amplitude in Rondônia expanding over time.
Observe the strict bimodal cropping pattern in Punjab.
Cloud-interpolated flags are transparently logged for QC audit.
